options.pitch: Manchester Animation Festival will bar generative AI films from 2027, as Ottawa's festival says entrants are lying on their forms, and festivals decide which animated films win distribution deals. Festival selection, which decides awards and distribution for animated films, rests on a form filmmakers fill in themselves, and programmers say the form and the film no longer match, so every animator entering festivals knows the box is being gamed.

A Binding of Isaac update shipped Suno-made music with no AI label on Steam, and players found Suno's tag inside the music files' metadata. A video game store's AI label depends on the developer ticking a box, and this time a file's own metadata told players the truth, so anyone releasing a game, an album or a video knows the file can disclose what the label did not.
options.why_now: Eurogamer and PC Gamer, 20 to 22 Nov 2026.

options.pitch: Tencent Music, owner of QQ Music, Kugou and Kuwo, told investors on 17 November that streams of AI content are negligible because listeners are more selective, while its chairman also said its own controls keep AI plays low. Every artist and label hearing that AI music does not sell knows the number was partly set by the platform.
options.why_now: Tencent Music third-quarter 2026 earnings call, 17 Nov 2026.
